faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) for its research project requirements under advertisement number SPON/62058/Advt0332.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised position is Project Manager, which is a temporary role established under the C-NARMADA project framework at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Manager post, offering an excellent opportunity for qualified research and administrative professionals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Project Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Project Manager position is 2 October 2026. Candidates should apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Manager position will receive a monthly salary ranging between ₹60,000/- and ₹1,25,000/- based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants need a B.Tech/B.E/M.Sc/M.C.A/LLM/CA/CMA/CS/MBA/M.Com with 4 years experience OR B.C.A/B.Sc/B.A/B.Com/B.B.A/LLB with 8 years experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for IIT Gandhinagar Project Manager Recruitment 2026 is strictly online through the official project recruitment portal provided by the institute.

faq.question: Q8. Where can candidates apply online for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official recruitment website at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ before the final submission deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Gandhinagar Project Manager?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes shortlisting candidates based on eligibility criteria, followed by a selection test or interview conducted by the institute.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for applying to IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making the online application process free of any monetary charges for interested candidates.
